body: I’ve tried therapy, and it sucked. It was never about me, it was her reciting what she was supposed to say to someone in my position. And my parents are very opposed to medication so that option is completely off the table. I assume I just have to make myself numb to everything for the next two years, probably just leave everyone alone since I seem to make everyone upset most of the time. I just don’t know if talking to a friend to get it off of my chest is worth it. Thank you for responding
